APPROVE
The extraction keeps the same site order and branch logic, splits complexity so every method lands well under 15 (`JsClassifyUnit` is about 13), and is behaviour-preserving; I couldn't build it because the repo isn't here, so check that `JsInventory.Inventory`/`JsInventory.Package` are the real type names and that `Site` is a class (not a struct, which would break `sites.Add(site)` on a `Site?`).
